title: Minimal selfhood can be controlled in the laboratory

statements.text: Minimal phenomenal selfhood can be experimentally manipulated, as in full-body illusions induced with virtual reality and synchronous touch, which shift self-identification and self-location toward an avatar. Ownership can be manipulated by passive exposure to correlated self-related signals, as in the rubber hand illusion.

sources.quote: the phenomenal experience of ownership can be manipulated merely by passive exposure to correlations among self-related signals
